data-in.name: data-in
data-in.summary: The element arrives at this cue.

data-describe.name: data-describe
data-describe.summary: The subject of the reveal, which the runtime gives a verb per moment. An empty phrase means decorative.

data-tex.name: data-tex
data-tex.summary: Typeset with KaTeX, with the element's own text as the readable fallback.

data-tex-display.name: data-tex-display
data-tex-display.summary: Typeset the TeX as a display equation on its own line rather than inline.

data-in-style.name: data-in-style
data-in-style.summary: How the element arrives. Each word declares its own span.

data-back.name: data-back
data-back.summary: The element steps back at this cue, dimmed but still readable.

data-front.name: data-front
data-front.summary: The element returns to full strength at this cue.

data-out.name: data-out
data-out.summary: The element leaves at this cue.

data-words.name: data-words
data-words.summary: The line is shown word by word on the voice, matched against the section's spoken words.

data-count.name: data-count
data-count.summary: A number in the text counts up from zero when the element arrives.

data-class.name: data-class
data-class.summary: Adds a class at a moment, written as moment:name pairs, for the page's own stylesheet.

data-describe-class.name: data-describe-class
data-describe-class.summary: What each class change means, as moment:phrase pairs separated by a vertical bar.

data-stagger.name: data-stagger
data-stagger.summary: The container's children arrive this far apart from one cue.

data-steps.name: data-steps
data-steps.summary: Each cued child comes to the front as it arrives and the ones before it step back.

data-in-seconds.name: data-in-seconds
data-in-seconds.summary: How long the entrance plays, which governs the entrance alone and never the onset.

data-swaps.name: data-swaps
data-swaps.summary: The element takes the place of whatever leaves on its own arrival cue, in a held swap.

data-describe-out.name: data-describe-out
data-describe-out.summary: Overrides the departure sentence when leaving means something of its own.

data-scene.name: data-scene
data-scene.summary: Declares the scene a section names, on the wrapper that holds its slides.

data-name.name: data-name
data-name.summary: The scene's name in the index and in the catalog.

data-slide.name: data-slide
data-slide.summary: Declares a slide on a template. Its id qualifies every moment written inside it.

data-hold.name: data-hold
data-hold.summary: How long the preview rests on this slide. No recording reads it.

data-owns.name: data-owns
data-owns.summary: Local names of cues only a handler serves, which no moment attribute mentions.

data-enter.name: data-enter
data-enter.summary: How this slide replaces the one before it.

exempt.data-describe: Any phrase clears the finding, so no value of it can change a verdict.
exempt.data-describe-class: The transcript prints the phrase verbatim, so no value of it can change a verdict.
exempt.data-describe-out: It replaces one transcript sentence with another, and neither is measured.
exempt.data-hold: The preview alone reads it, and a preview is never recorded.
exempt.data-name: It names a scene in the index, which no check and no finding reads.

PAGE_UNKNOWN_ATTR.message: {attr} is not an attribute this contract defines, so check its spelling against the attribute table.

PAGE_BAD_VALUE.message: {attr}={value} is not one of {allowed}, so write one of those instead.

PAGE_MOMENT_UNKNOWN.message: {attr}={value} names a cue slide {slide} does not own, so declare it on the slide or correct the name.

PAGE_MOMENT_ORDER.message: The exit {value} is at or before the entrance on the same element, so give the exit a later cue.

PAGE_CUE_UNKNOWN.message: The cue {cue} is not one this deck declares, so remove it or name it in a moment attribute.

PAGE_NO_OWNER.message: No slide owns the cue {cue}, so name it in a moment attribute or list it in data-owns.

PAGE_SCENE_EMPTY.message: The scene {slide} declares no slide, so add a template to it or remove the scene.

PAGE_SLIDE_NO_ID.message: A template carries no data-slide, so give it the id a section names.

PAGE_SLIDE_DOUBLED.message: Two templates claim the slide id {slide}, so every moment local to it has two owners.

PAGE_SLIDE_UNUSED.message: Slide {slide} is never shown, so nothing it declares reaches a recording.

PAGE_TEMPLATE_IGNORED.message: A template inside slide {slide} declares no slide of its own, so nothing ever mounts it.

PAGE_WORDS_NOT_FOUND.message: The line {value} is not among the spoken words, so it cannot be shown word by word.

PAGE_KATEX_MISSING.message: KaTeX is not loaded, so {attr} is left as the author wrote it.

PAGE_KATEX_ERROR.message: KaTeX refused {value}, so the element shows its readable fallback text.

PAGE_FREEZE_CUE_UNKNOWN.message: The cue {cue} is not one of slide {slide}'s cues, so the freeze stopped at nothing.

PAGE_RENDER_THREW.message: The render handler for slide {slide} threw {value}, so the slide is drawn as its markup stands.

PAGE_ENTER_THREW.message: The enter handler for slide {slide} threw {value}, so the slide arrived without it.

PAGE_SLIDE_HANDLER_THREW.message: The handler slide {slide} registered for cue {cue} threw {value}, so that moment did nothing.

PAGE_HANDLER_THREW.message: The handler the deck registered for cue {cue} threw {value}, so that moment did nothing.

PAGE_WAIT_REJECTED.message: A promise the page waited for rejected with {value}, so the page was drawn without it.

PAGE_WAIT_UNSETTLED.message: A promise the page waited for never settled, so the page was drawn without it.

PAGE_CLASS_UNDESCRIBED.message: data-class names {value} with no phrase for it in data-describe-class, so the transcript loses it.

PAGE_CLASS_NOT_REDUCED.message: The class {value} still animates under reduced motion, so the page's own stylesheet must honour it.

PAGE_SWAP_AMBIGUOUS.message: data-swaps at cue {cue} found {value} elements leaving, so name the one it replaces with a shared cue.

PAGE_PREVIEW_AMBIGUOUS.message: Two sections name the scene {slide}, so a preview cannot tell which one's cue times to play.

PAGE_APPEAR_TOO_LONG.message: data-words=appear is on a line of {value} words, so shorten it or use highlight instead.

PAGE_STAGGER_EMPTY.message: The container at cue {cue} staggers no children, so give it children or remove the attribute.

PAGE_MOTION_OVERRUN.message: The motion at cue {cue} is still playing {value} s later, at the frame the next cue is read from.

PAGE_STAGGER_OVERRUN.message: The stagger at cue {cue} runs {value} s in all, which passes the half second a cue may still move.

PAGE_WORD_LATE.message: The first synced word of {value} was shown after the voice reached it, so the line trails the speech.

PAGE_THIN_DRAW.message: The stroke at cue {cue} sweeps {value} percent of the frame, which is under the change floor.

PAGE_NO_DESCRIPTION.message: The element at cue {cue} has no text and no data-tex, so give it data-describe or an empty one.

PAGE_SWAP_APART.message: The swap at cue {cue} lands {value} percent over the box it replaces, so the two may read as unrelated.

PAGE_STALLED.message: The page stopped drawing {value} s into the recording, so every later cue was captured on a dead frame.

PAGE_BLACK.message: The frame at cue {cue} is black, so nothing the slide declares was on screen when the voice arrived.

PAGE_TRUNCATED.message: The recording ends {value} s before the narration does, so the last cues are not in it.

PAGE_CDN_ASSET.message: The page loaded {value} from another origin, so the film depends on a host it does not own.

query.scene: Play this scene from its first slide.
query.slide: Freeze this slide with its cues already fired, which is what a screenshot opens.
query.cues: The cue times to fire at, as id@seconds pairs separated by a comma.
query.words: The spoken words to sync a line against, as word@seconds pairs separated by a comma.
query.t0: The narration second the page starts at, or the word signal when the recorder starts the clock.
query.speed: Multiply the preview clock, so a long section is reviewed quickly.
query.hud: Draw the on-page clock and cue list, which is for an author and never for a recording.
query.after: Freeze after this cue, so the cues up to and including it fire and later ones stay hidden.
query.before: Freeze just before this cue, so it and every later cue stay hidden.

report.version: The runtime version the page carries.
report.mode: Which of index, preview, cue and freeze the page is in.
report.scene: The scene the page is playing, or null on the index page.
report.slide: The slide on screen, or null when none is mounted.
report.warnings: Every distinct warning the page reported, as code, message, slide, cue and attr.
report.catalog: One entry per scene, with its slides, its cues and the measured box of every element.
report.cues: When each cue was due, when it ran, and when the frames around it began.
report.words: Each synced line, when its cue ran, when the voice reaches it and when its first word showed.
report.frameGaps: Every gap between two animation frames longer than the recorder can absorb.
report.longFrames: Every animation frame that took longer than a captured frame, with when it was presented.
